class.name: VoxelSdfMaterialLibrary
class.brief_description: Indexed material library for multi-material SDF meshing.
class.description: Stores materials by voxel material index. Entry [code]materials[N][/code] is used for mesh surfaces emitted with material index [code]N[/code].

method.name: get_material_by_index
method.description: Returns the material at [param index], or [code]null[/code] if the index is outside [member materials].

method.name: get_material_index_count
method.description: Returns the number of material slots in [member materials].

members.member: Material array indexed directly by voxel material ID.
